creation_statements: CREATE ROLE "{{name}}" WITH LOGIN INHERIT NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS CONNECTION LIMIT 2 PASSWORD '{{password}}' VALID UNTIL '{{expiration}}'; DO $ttl$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" VALID UNTIL %L',clock_timestamp()+INTERVAL 'PAM_TTL_SECONDS seconds'); END $ttl$; GRANT securegate_pam_diagnostics TO "{{name}}"; ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" SET statement_timeout='5s'; ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" SET idle_session_timeout='30s'; ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout='10s';
revocation_statements: DO $revoke$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='{{name}}') THEN ALTER ROLE "{{name}}" NOLOGIN; PERFORM pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename='{{name}}' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid(); DROP ROLE "{{name}}"; END IF; END $revoke$;
